hero.title: Nationwide Auto Transport
hero.description: Vetted carriers, auction pickup, dealer delivery, port warehouse delivery, private relocations, BOL documentation, and status updates. One dispatch team.

audience.shipMyCarDesc: Door-to-door anywhere in the US. Open or enclosed transport with status updates at every stage.
audience.dealersDesc: Auction pickup, dealer trades, volume pricing. One broker for Copart, IAAI, and Manheim.
audience.dealersStat: Flat per-vehicle fee · Carrier payments handled
audience.exportersDesc: Any US auction to any US port. Gate pass coordination and warehouse delivery.
audience.exportersStat: All major US ports · Container ready

benefits.title: Your Complete Transport Solution
benefits.quoteAnywhereDesc: Get a quote from your phone, desktop, or Telegram bot. Y7 support is digital-first — no sales calls, no phone tag.
benefits.realTimeDesc: Track progress via Telegram, email, or customer portal. Updates at every stage.
benefits.transparentDesc: Carrier rate + flat service fee. No hidden charges. Price locked before dispatch.
benefits.flexibleDesc: Pay on delivery or prepay. Volume pricing for dealers. Weekly invoicing available.
benefits.verifiedDesc: Every carrier checked through Central Dispatch. FMCSA authority and insurance verified.
benefits.documentationDesc: BOL at pickup and delivery. Photo documentation. Driver contact details shared via portal for delivery coordination.

steps.submitDesc: Enter your VIN and route details. We decode your vehicle instantly and show estimated pricing.
steps.priceDesc: Receive a competitive price range within 1 hour during business hours. Confirm when you are ready — no pressure.
steps.signDesc: Quick digital signature on our transport agreement. Review terms, check boxes, type your name.
steps.carrierDesc: We match your load with a vetted carrier from our network. You get carrier name and phone.
steps.deliveredDesc: Follow your shipment status via portal. Inspect on arrival, sign BOL, and you are done.

whyY7.title: Why Shippers Choose Y7
whyY7.licensedDesc: USDOT #4427359, MC #1741537. Licensed property broker with $75,000 BMC-84 surety bond.
whyY7.verifiedDesc: 90% of our orders go through CD. Verified broker with top ratings.
whyY7.transparentDesc: No hidden fees. Carrier rate + service fee. What you see is what you pay.
whyY7.statusDesc: Monitor your shipment via portal, email, SMS, or Telegram. For delivery coordination, driver contact details appear in your portal after dispatch.
whyY7.multilingualDesc: EN, RU, PL, UA — we speak your language. Global exporter network.
whyY7.fastDesc: Quotes typically within 1 hour during business hours. Dedicated dispatch coordinator.

trustSection.title: How we protect your shipment
trustSection.carrierVettingDesc: Every carrier verified through Central Dispatch. FMCSA authority, active insurance, safety rating checked before assignment.
trustSection.insuranceDesc: COI confirmed before every dispatch. Minimum $100K cargo coverage required. Most carriers carry $250K+.
trustSection.documentationDesc: BOL at pickup and delivery. Photo documentation. Digital records accessible in your customer portal.
trustSection.notificationsDesc: Email at every stage. Telegram bot for updates. Portal access to shipment status anytime.
trustSection.claimsDesc: 24-hour claim window with photo documentation. We coordinate with the carrier's insurance on your behalf.
trustSection.escalationDesc: Dispatcher → operations manager → resolution within 48 hours. Every issue gets tracked.
